request.message: For how many years after the effective date of the Merger does PSS agree to file all reports required by Section 13 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934?

response.answer: PSS agrees to file all reports required by Section 13 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for a period of three years after the effective date of the Merger [E1][E5].

evidences.doc_title: Gulf South Medical Supply Affiliate Agreement (1997)
section_path: 6. Filing of Reports by PSS. PSS agrees, for a period of three years
evidences.text:
------------------------
after the effective date of the Merger, to file on a timely basis all reports
required to be filed by it pursuant to Section 13 of the Securities Exchange Act
of 1934, as amended, so that the public information provisions of Rule 145(d)
promulgated by the SEC as the same are presently in effect will be available to
the undersigned in the event the undersigned desires to transfer any shares of
PSS Common Stock issued to the undersigned pursuant to the Merger.
